detailed_description: This line drawing depicts a kitchen space, likely a kitchenette. To the left, a tall shelving unit with multiple shelves, some containing books, stands prominently. Above the stove, an extractor hood is drawn. Two windows with a cross-pane design are visible on the back wall above the counter. In the center of the room, a rectangular island or table is present, with a bowl containing fruit, including bananas and round fruits, placed on its surface. A small rug or mat is drawn on the floor to the right of the island, and a long, narrow object resembling a rug or mat is also visible in the lower right corner. A person is depicted standing near the island, and a cradle is also present in the scene, although its placement is unclear.
